messages:
mike: Heads-up — customer (acct 6247) reports duplicate resources + unexpected 409s after we shipped regenerated SDKs this morning. They saw retries create new items and get billed twice. Repro steps below.

mike: Repro (curl):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/uploads \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: multipart/form-data' \n  -F 'file=@foo.bin' \
  # note: no idempotency header set by server
```

mike: Repro (python sdk):
```py
from redwood_sdk import UploadClient
cli = UploadClient(api_key=os.getenv('TOKEN'))
cli.upload_file('foo.bin')  # previously set X-Idempotency-Key header in generated client; new client no longer does
```

rong: Thanks — can you attach the spec diff? Any OpenAPI change around idempotencyKey or header parameters?

mike: Link: https://internal-git/redwood/openapi/compare/refs/changes/890a..b12c — the multipart schema had an optional header param removed: `X-Idempotency-Key` moved out of the operation-level params (looks like generator quirk when an allOf collapsed).

amelia: Oh no. So regenerated clients dropped client-side header wiring. That explains missing idempotency header -> retries recreate resource -> 409/duplicate billing.

ci-bot: regen-ci: job 2249991234 produced clients/python and clients/ts diffs. Failing tests: none (unit tests only). Integration tests were skipped for regen job.

rong: Quick mitigation: I can publish a patch release for python+ts that injects X-Idempotency-Key on upload if caller doesn't provide one. Will open PRs. Also reverting the single offending regen commit in the release branch until we have a spec fix.

mike: Please include steps for customers to patch workarounds. I've opened support ticket S-7891 and escalated to CS — customer asked for rollback.

amelia: Longer-term: add a regen-guard to the CI that flags OpenAPI contract contractions (removal of operation-level header params) and require a changelog entry + manual approval. Also will add an integration test that runs a canned upload against a sandboxed API to assert presence of idempotency header in generated clients (basic smoke).

rong: Filing PRs now: #4123 (python hotfix), #4124 (ts hotfix). Patch will set header if missing and emit a deprecation warning when calling the convenience `upload_file` helper.

mike: Customer notified. They want confirmation when rollback is live. Also requested audit log of any duplicate billing charges — billing team looped in.

amelia: Assigned: devex -> add regen CI contract-guard (ticket DEVEX-2012). eng-ml/infra to check generator template that collapsed optional headers.

rong: Noted. I'll also add a smoke test to regen job to catch this class of bug.

mike: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

ci-bot: action items created: DEVEX-2012, SDK-4123, SDK-4124, S-7891.
